item.description:
Connect your AI agent to Screenshottr

  • Enable agent access in Settings to let Codex, Claude Code, and other local agents work directly with Screenshottr while the app is open.
  • Copy one setup message to connect your agent and install the included Screenshottr skill. Advanced connection controls remain visible.
  • Use agents to organize projects and screenshots, discover and apply saved styles, add annotations and redactions, crop, preview, and export PNGs.
  • Agent edits use Screenshottr’s normal undo and save history. Applying styles preserves crops and redactions, and exports never overwrite existing files.
  • Agent access is off by default. Turn it off at any time or reset the connection token to revoke existing connections.

Native macOS 27 appearance

  • Window controls and toolbars now use the current native macOS glass appearance.
  • Improved stability when reopening a project with the inspector visible.
  • Keep the canvas centered when showing or hiding the sidebar and inspector.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Includes Apple silicon and Intel support.

New screenshots, ready to edit

  • Turn on automatic Photos importing to add new screenshots to your current project as they arrive in your Mac's Photos library, including screenshots synced from your iPhone through iCloud.
  • New screenshots inherit your composition style and a compatible device frame. Importing waits while you edit, saves your work, and avoids duplicates.
  • Keep importing enabled to catch up on missed screenshots when you reopen Screenshottr.
  • The Fit and zoom menu now uses native Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later.
  • Includes the Photos access capability required for macOS to show its permission request.
